review_method: Every updated image was visually inspected as an original-versus-staged comparison render on an isolated non-deploying helper branch. PNG/WebP twins use extension-specific filenames and transparency is composited over a checkerboard for review.
safeguards: Helper comparison renders and helper workflow files are not on the staging branch and are not part of the merge candidate.
No customer download masters, client-owned/client-supplied media, or site code were modified.
GitHub Actions independently required matching decoded pixels, alpha, ICC profile, frame count, and compressed picture data for every edited image.
